title: Version 0.130.0 with Plugin Details and Remote Control
description: May 8, 2026 release (v0.130.0) adds plugin details showing bundled hooks, plugin sharing with discoverability controls, codex remote-control command, and Bedrock auth with AWS console-login credentials.

title: Version 0.129.0 with TUI Improvements and Plugin Management
description: May 7, 2026 release (v0.129.0) introduces modal Vim editing in composer, redesigned resume/fork picker, plugin workspace sharing and access controls, and hooks browsing/toggling from /hooks.

title: Rate Limits Doubled for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise Plans
description: On May 6, 2026, Claude Code five-hour rate limits were doubled for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans, with peak-hours throttling also addressed.

title: Version 3.3 Bug Fixes
description: May 6, 2026 update (v3.3) fixed various cloud agent timing and hydration edge cases affecting reliability, plus performance improvements.

title: Version 2.2.17 with Devin Review and Quick Review
description: May 6, 2026 release (v2.2.17) makes Devin Review & Quick Review available to all users, improves Agent Command Center, fixes Windows bugs, and enhances MCP server and Devin Local agent reliability.

title: Analytics Governance Documentation Update
description: May 6, 2026 update to Codex enterprise governance guide with more detailed coverage of Analytics dashboard charts, data export options, and enterprise Analytics API endpoints.

title: Model Controls, Spend Management, and Usage Analytics for Enterprise
description: May 4, 2026 release introduces model controls for enterprise users, spend management tools, and usage analytics dashboard targeting Enterprise admins.

title: Version 0.128.0 with Goal Workflows and Permission Profiles
description: April 30, 2026 release (v0.128.0) adds persisted /goal workflows with app-server APIs, permission profiles with built-in defaults, expanded plugin management with marketplace installation, and external agent session import.

title: Agentic Workflows in Visual Studio
description: April 30, 2026 update focuses on agentic workflows with cloud agent sessions launching directly from IDE and enhanced custom agent capabilities.
